item_short_desc: Gear up with Rothco’s Enhanced Belt Keepers, the ultimate accessory for securing your duty belt. Crafted from rugged polyester, these keepers feature 2 snap closures and an inner hook patch, ensuring your belt stays in place during intense situations. The belt keepers comein a 4-pack, ideal for most duty belt setups. Trusted by public safety professionals and first responders, these keepers are expertly designed to fit most belts, measuring 7.25 inches x 1 inch when open and 2.5 inches x 1 inch when closed.
